newsitem.title: USA: Pennzoil says Liedtke does not back UPR bid.
newsitem.headline: Pennzoil says Liedtke does not back UPR bid.

text.p: Pennzoil Co on Tuesday denied a newspaper report that said J. Hugh Liedtke, the founder of the modern Pennzoil, would support a hostile bid for the company by Union Pacific Resources Group Inc (UPR).

In a statement issued by the oil company in response to an article in Tuesday's editions of the newspaper USA Today, Liedtke was quoted as saying he was "not backing the takeover of Pennzoil by Union Pacific Resources."
"I do not intend to tender any of my Pennzoil shares pursuant to the UPR offer," Liedtke said.
Liedtke was chairman of Pennzoil for 27 years until he retired in 1994. According to the proxy statement for that year, he was the beneficial owner of 151,000 shares.
